parameters.name: AiDetect
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the alert was detected by AI. Valid values:
- true: The alert was detected by AI.
- false: The alert was not detected by AI.

parameters.name: BatchType
parameters.description:
The batch operation type. Valid values:

- **sha256**: same file content.

- **eventName**: same alerting type.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Md5
parameters.description: The MD5 hash of the file.

parameters.name: OssKey
parameters.description: The storage key of the file in the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paging query.

parameters.name: ParentEventId
parameters.description:
If the file is a sub-file within a compressed archive, **ParentEventId** specifies the event ID of the alert for the compressed archive itself.

To retrieve and query alert events for sub-files within a compressed archive:

1. Call this operation and check the **HasSubEvent** response parameter. If the value is **true**, the corresponding **EventId** is the event ID of the alert for the compressed archive itself.
2. Call this operation again and pass the **EventId** value to **ParentEventId** to view the alert events for the sub-files within the compressed archive.

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level. Valid values:

- **high**: High risk.

- **medium**: Medium risk.

- **low**: Low risk.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The data source. Valid values:
- **API**: API-based detection.
- **OSS**: OSS-based detection.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The event status. Valid values:

- 0: Unhandled. 
- 1: Manually handled.
- 2: Whitelisted.
- 3: Ignored.
- 4: Access blocked.

parameters.name: TimeEnd
parameters.description: The end time of the time range during which the anomalous event occurred.

parameters.name: TimeStart
parameters.description: The start time of the time range during which the anomalous event occurred.
